entities.summary: Brianna Decker is an American former professional ice hockey forward who is currently an assistant coach for the Minnesota Frost of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). She played for the Boston Blades, Boston Pride, Calgary Inferno, Professional Women's Hockey Players Association, and United States women's national ice hockey team. She played college ice hockey at Wisconsin and won the 2012 Patty Kazmaier Award. With the Boston Pride, she scored the first hat trick in NWHL history on October 25, 2015. Decker was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame in 2025.
